noun_definition: Assistance workflow refers to the sequence of actions and navigation paths a user follows to receive help or support within the application, specifically in relation to the "Get Assistance" feature on the bank account page.
Bank account page refers to the section within the application where users can connect their bank account as part of the workflow process.
Workflow refers to a sequence of actions or processes that users can follow within the application, specifically related to managing assistance and navigation from the bank account page.
